facts.text: The PN300 is a Digimess programmable power supply controlled over GPIB
The instrument is identified with *IDN? on connection
Source A or B is selected with SEL_A or SEL_B
The active source is read with SEL? and its reply contains SEL_A or SEL_B
The output is switched on with OUT_ON and off with OUT_OFF
The output state is read with OUT?
The operating mode is selected with OPER_IND, OPER_TRAC or OPER_PAR and read with OPER?
The source is constant current with CONT_CC or constant voltage with CONT_CV, read with CONT?
The voltage setpoint is written as VSET <volts> and read with VSET?
The current setpoint is written as ISET <amperes> and read with ISET?
The measured output voltage and current are read with VOUT? and IOUT?
The protection mode is read with PROT? and the reply names LIMITING or CUT-OUT

measures.description: Protection mode read with PROT?: LIM (limiting) or CUT (cut-out)
measures.name: protection

operator_required.name: voltage
operator_required.reason: The upstream code states the voltage setpoint in volts but gives no voltage range; the operator sets the deployment bound in site-limits.json.

operator_required.name: current
operator_required.reason: The upstream docstring gives only mode-dependent current ranges, written with non-numeric glyphs; no single bound is stated, so the operator sets the deployment bound in site-limits.json.
